notes.title: Game Update: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Detailed Notes:
We appreciate your continued support and feedback! Here's a breakdown of the bug fixes included in this update:

1. UI Resolution Handling Error Fixed:
- We've corrected a persistent issue where the judgment window failed to adapt properly to various UI resolutions. Previously, players might have experienced display inconsistencies. With this fix, the judgment window will now display correctly and consistently, regardless of your screen resolution settings. This ensures a smoother and more reliable visual experience during gameplay.

2. Status Window Information Not Updating Fixed:
- A bug that prevented character information in the status window from refreshing in real-time has been resolved. Previously, changes to character stats or status effects might not have been immediately reflected. Now, your character's details in the status window will always be accurately and instantly updated, providing you with precise information about your character's current state.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve the game! We're committed to delivering a stable and enjoyable experience for everyone.

notes.title: Sanity - debuff system has been updated.
notes.notes:
[b]Sanity - debuff system has been updated.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/978c6d86fb64622ded6f0dab73af41cc3cb4a45b.png[/img]

In the case of the debuff system, they will be back-to-back as the Sanity check progresses. 



[b]1. Successful Sanity Check[/b]
If the Sanity Test is successful, one of the following options will be selected and applied (No Change / Increased Sanity / Increased Condition) with a respective probability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/6947a8872f434458ffcb13983d6a09492518066a.png[/img]

[b]2. failed Sanity test[/b]
If the sanity test fails, one of the following options will be selected and applied (Sanity Decrease / Insanity Decrease / Condition Decrease).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/2d277b5ec930ae3131fb6f746541fb94d34e2f2b.png[/img]

There are three stages of insanity, and when you reach the third stage, the percentage will be transferred to the lowered condition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/1630740d0130c77ecd672dac7bc532d3a1cc2e1d.png[/img]

Insanity Phase 1 is a numerical change that doesn't affect gameplay much.

Insanity Phase 2 adds debuffs that can disrupt gameplay in addition to the numerical changes.

Insanity Level 3 gives you numerical and graphical debuffs that severely disrupt gameplay.



This concludes all updates for the demo, if you are interested in future updates, please purchase the game. Thank you.

notes.title: Status UI / Shop / Battle system introduced
notes.notes:
[b]Battle system, Shop and status UI updates![/b]

[b]1. combat system.[/b]
TRPG's combat system allows you to enjoy a combat experience.
It can be broken down into two main parts.
[h3][u][b]Battles can happen if you stay up late into the evening![/b][/u][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/cdd8397ca2ba0e6ac61ed46a5513dba07e264a3c.png[/img]

1) Your Action Turn
During your action turn, you choose what actions you want to take. In the current version, fleeing is not updated, but eventually there will be 3 options: attack / reload / flee.
If you choose Attack, you will specify who you want to attack and start making judgments. Shooting and Dexterity judgments are one-sided as before, while Martial Arts and Swordsmanship are compared against each other and the result of the action is chosen based on the results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/87eafe7dce522d5ec3fbffa3483ac90e5de0e83b.png[/img]

2) Enemy's Action Turn
There are two options for the enemy's action turn. "Dodge" and "Counterattack".
Dodging has the advantage if they are both successful, i.e. the same number of judgment points. Counterattack is the opposite, giving you a disadvantage if you both succeed.






[b]2. Shop[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/cc04072bcc9d259d0c10bd1e93e039e1a73133fa.png[/img]

A place called "GUNSHOP" has now been added to the map in Upper Arkham. You can go there to buy firearms, ammunition, swords, drugs, and throwing objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/1d046a5b07540c02af48f66c9d78d5bd08fb9f33.png[/img]





[b]3. Staters UI[/b]
A total of three UIs have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/500e8290dbecf693083e1d8ff66322ce4a275a07.png[/img]

1) Stat UI
You can check your character's stats when you create your character and the debuffs you currently have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/713c543c63aac85e88827054fdd9b75f4d383aff.png[/img]

2) Inventory UI
You can check the items you currently have. It is categorized into equipable, consumable, and key items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/84759ce50b73c5037c4953cd351d6fbc15da7841.png[/img]

3) Skill UI
You can check the skills you specified when creating your character.

This is the biggest update since the Early Access release.
After the next "Debuff System" update, we will no longer be updating the demo version.
Thanks to all of you for your continued support. Thank you!

notes.title: Your detective's notebook has been updated!
notes.notes:
[b]The first updates will follow the post-launch roadmap.[/b]

Here are the details

[b]1. detective notebook[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/2cc2c3882e5028b86e995328b1f34b00fdaed7c9.png[/img]

You can now use the Detective Notebook to more easily verify and assign keyword information you've already obtained. Press the number key '1' to turn it on and click on the categories at the top and left to read the information.


[b]2. bug fixes and changes[/b]

1) Bugfix - Fixed an issue where the player's position in the master bedroom of the client's house was strange.

2) Bugfix - Fixed an issue where  Sanity numbers were not properly reflected in the bottom UI.

3) Scenario fix - Fixed an issue where alligator and crocodile were being used interchangeably when using the word "alligator".

4) Scenario fix - The "safe" keyword is split. Now, when you acquire a safe, you will acquire an additional keyword.

5) Key Change - The map key has been changed from the old "M" button to the number key "1". This was done to address the issue of traveling too far when playing.

6) added tutorial - Added pages 10-13 of the main game to the tutorial, covering using the map and using the detective notebook.

notes.title: Publish A Shadow Cast on Water Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi, I wanted to share a detailed development schedule and[b] roadmap[/b].

Please note that this schedule is an optimistic target and may actually take a bit longer.

However, we'll try to stick to the schedule as much as possible, and even if we run into problems, we'll still be working hard to complete development within [b]2023[/b].

The detailed schedule is as follows

-----



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/3226a51e7e786639ecda65be297152b3a50f9e52.png[/img]


[b]( 1. Detective Notebook )[/b]
This system will be used to make it easier to manage the keywords you have already acquired.
You can record the information at the time of acquisition and check it again, and you can easily select keywords to use using the UI.

[b]( 2. User Status & Inventory UI )[/b]
A UI is added to check the stats and current status of the character created by the user.
In addition, an inventory will be added where you can check and use your acquired items.

[b]( 3. Turn-based combat system )[/b]
The game will be based on the turn-based combat system of TRPGs.
The combat will be balanced to be difficult enough to encourage dodging if possible.

[b]( 4. Insanity System )[/b]
This is a kind of debuff system that can be obtained through judgment when the user's sanity level reaches a certain level (70,50,25%).
The 1st debuffs is a simple debuff that doesn't affect play much.
Tier 2nd debuffs are more disruptive and penalize certain actions.
Tier 3rd debuffs will consist of debuffs that are significantly disruptive to play and have a bit of theatrics that can be shocking.


[b]( 5. ~Day 4 Complete the story )[/b]
Complete the story that is stuck on Day 1, and add an ending. 
I'm thinking of multiple endings, and I'm thinking of 3 main endings with slightly different details.

[b]( 6. Additional Directing & Content )[/b]
This is a task to enrich the game by adding cutscenes, standing illustrations, gore effects, etc. for battles and story progression.

[b]( 7. Final inspection & Add a language )[/b]
We will be doing a final inspection and adding various languages before the game is officially released.
The languages we are currently thinking about are Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Russian, which may expand or contract further.

-----

This is the detailed timeline we are currently planning, and it is subject to change.
But we'll do our best to keep everything on schedule and functional.

Thank you in advance for your interest.

notes.title: Announcing the start of sales and upcoming events.
notes.notes:
[b]Thanks to more interest than we could have ever imagined, we're finally able to release the game.[/b]


From now on, we will continue to work on the game until it's ready with regular updates.

Currently, we are developing a [b]"detective notebook"[/b] where users can check the information of the keywords they have obtained, as shown below.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215386/4a834f15b1cd431d19c55e5f64195136e8fcf7d7.png[/img]


In addition to simply viewing the information, the keyword selection part, which was previously cumbersome, can be specified more easily through the detective notebook will be made easier.

We'll be releasing a full development roadmap and regular announcement schedule by the end of this week.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
